Package com.noorlandmc.NoorNPCs.service

Class NPCSkinProvider

java.lang.Object
com.noorlandmc.NoorNPCs.service.NPCSkinProvider
public final class NPCSkinProvider extends Object
Handles skin selection and application for NPC mannequins.

Skin selection priority in assignSkin(com.noorlandmc.NoorNPCs.model.NPCData):

  1. If the NPC's name matches a defined-npcs entry the fixed skin from that entry is used unconditionally — this is the override that fires whenever NPCNameProvider happened to pick a defined-NPC name during the rarity roll.
  2. Otherwise a random skin is chosen from the sex-appropriate pool.

The skin-debug menu and all persistence paths are unaffected because they go through getAllSkins() and getSkinById(String) which still return the full combined list.

      public NPCSkinProvider.NPCSkin assignSkin(NPCData data)
      Assigns a skin to data and records all skin fields on it.

      If the NPC's name matches a defined-NPC entry that skin is applied; otherwise a sex-appropriate random skin is chosen.

      Returns:
      the assigned skin, or null if no skins are configured

    • applySkin

      public void applySkin(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin mannequin, NPCData data)
      Applies the skin information from NPCData to a live mannequin.

      If a canonical definition exists for the stored skinId (or the NPC name maps to a defined-NPC), the canonical texture values take precedence — this means texture updates in the config are reflected on the next spawn/reload without touching persistence.
